name: Quarry Hauler
oracle_text: When this creature enters, for each kind of counter on target permanent, put another counter of that kind on it or remove one from it.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, for each kind of counter on target permanent, put another counter of that kind on it or remove one from it.

needs.what: remove_counters accepting counter: {"binding": <kind>} so that, inside a for_each_counter_kind body, a two-mode choose_mode can say 'put another counter of that kind on it (add_counters with the bound kind) or remove one from it (remove_counters amount 1 of the bound kind)', asked once per kind
